caseSignoff.heading: Sign-off
caseSignoff.ready: Every action is done and there is evidence that has been checked. Someone else who can sign off then closes the case.
caseSignoff.notReady.openActions: {count, plural, one {# action is still open.} other {# actions are still open.}}
caseSignoff.notReady.evidence: No evidence has been checked yet.
caseSignoff.refused.openActions: {count, plural, one {# action is still open. Complete or remove it, then request sign-off.} other {# actions are still open. Complete or remove them, then request sign-off.}}
caseSignoff.refused.evidenceMissing: Attach at least one piece of evidence, and wait until a file has been checked, then request sign-off.
caseSignoff.waiting.approver: {name} asked for sign-off on {time}. Read the assessment, the actions and the evidence above. Signing off closes the case under your name.
caseSignoff.waiting.self: You asked for sign-off on {time}. Someone else who can sign off has to give it.
caseSignoff.waiting.viewer: {name} asked for sign-off on {time}. Someone who can sign off will pick it up.
caseSignoff.noteHint: The note stays on the case and in its case file.
caseSignoff.fourEyes: You asked for this sign-off, so you can't give it. A second person has to sign off.
caseSignoff.stepUpCancelled: The case was not signed off. Sign off and close needs your passkey.
caseSignoff.sendBackBody: The case goes back to implementing and its actions can be changed again. {name} can ask for sign-off again when it is ready.
